content.topic_meaning: Estate stewardship expressed through administration connected to productive work and useful infrastructure.
rules: Every component and connecting relation must be visible together.
Prompt/audit validity does not establish pixel success.

tests.required: Reference protagonist gives an identifiable work direction; foreman visibly attends to that direction; actual yard work and its destination are in the same scene.
Loose grain being worked, grain sacks in a cart, its route/ramp, open dry store, and sacks inside are all visible as one linked process.
Plan diagram visibly corresponds to the circular paved floor, drain and store; real drain connects dry paving to lower wet ground. Mere board presence is insufficient.
Visible face/hair plausibly retains reference proportions, dark eyes, rounded outline and short dark bob with separated bangs; no real identity claim.
The image reads as a person directing an operating agricultural estate improvement, rather than only an aristocratic portrait or generic harvest.

content.concept: boundary petition in an indoor estate survey chamber
content.pixel_rule: Every component and connection of an adopted hard gate must be jointly visible; partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. Prompt and audit success are separate from pixels.

planned_tests.requires: Estate land-use representation plus an administrator making a decision tied to that land, with a corresponding administrative record; costume and loose papers alone fail.
Two petitioners visibly direct separate hands to the same boundary strip; their actual targets must be traceable, not inferred from proximity.
The map shows the complete boundary between distinguishable parcels and its bridge/stream endpoints; corresponding register outline and red amended boundary are visible and match.
Administrator hand/straightedge contact and the clerk writing in the corresponding register entry can be traced together.
Visible central face and dark short bob with wispy bangs can be compared with the supplied appearance reference; identity, age, biography and personality are not tested.

limits: Legal ownership and validity of the boundary decision cannot be proved by a still photograph.
Survey accuracy and previous survey history cannot be proved by these pixels.
A cause or completed administrative history is not established by costume, expressions or labels alone.
